requirement: A place's social pages are searched as from its country, and a city Google names in another script than the place's name stays out of the query and the locality match

oracle.invariant: S1: Kirami has no locality, localities [Al Barari] and country AE; the Japanese place keeps its Japanese city. S2: confirmed on the branch phone. S3: one query, 'Kirami Sushi Bar facebook', asked with {country: 'AE'}; the page is confirmed. S4: ScrapeCreators region=AE, Jina and SerpApi gl=ae, Firecrawl country ae; none of them sent without a country. S5: scrapecreators-google, jina, firecrawl, serpapi-google-search.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: searchPlaceOf: a city in another script than the name is left out; the Latin areas and the country stay
searchPlaceOf: a name and city in the same non-Latin script keep the city
match: a page naming one of the Latin areas (the neighbourhood) matches the locality
find: every search carries the place's country, and no query carries a city in another script
scrapeCreatorsGoogleSearch: a country becomes the region parameter
each adapter searches as from the place's country when given one, and as before without
